dateAssessment: The working calendar envelope is the unchanged session YAML, DR 1749-05-31–1749-06-07. The transcript speaks no month or day and does not establish all seven civil date boundaries; the time extraction is compatible, with incomplete coverage. The initial journey is explicitly unmeasured, and “a couple of days” describes Feywild social days whose conversion to Material Plane time is left variable (u0821–u0831). No individual event is assigned a civil date or watch from that envelope. Session 119’s closing handoff and watch data also supply no civil clock to carry forward. Perpetual afternoon light establishes no civil afternoon. Sorven’s late appraisal is narrated before the earlier training attempt it evaluates; its position within the couple-of-days montage remains open.
